last_change.summary: Added the issue #1004 adversarial-control apparatus/backend feature-support terms (participant_boundary_flow_resolution, participant_final_sink_mediation, participant_quarantined_processing, participant_processing_role_trust, participant_monitor_topology) to the API-407 evidence-required feature_support conditionals and added participant-flow-control-relation-v1 to the backend supported-contract enum as the owning realization contract for the flow, final-sink, and quarantine terms, so a backend can declare bounded flow resolution, final-sink mediation, quarantine, processing-role trust, and monitor topology as evidence-bound support.
